_comment: Copied to $DATA_DIR/loras.json on first start. Edit that copy; changes apply to the next request.
New defaults shipped here later are merged into that copy when it is read; the copy is never rewritten.
To switch a shipped default off on a pod, keep its line in loras.json with strength 0.
defaults: added to every render. required=true refuses renders when the file is missing on the pod;
required=false skips it with a warning, so a pod without that file still renders.
turbo=true (or 'turbo' in the file name) makes renders default to 8 steps instead of 30.
presets: named extra sets a request picks with lora_preset.
name can be the exact path in models/loras, the file name, or a unique part of it.
Only MiniMax H3 video LoRAs belong here: the Krea 2 image LoRAs live in image_loras.json.
